evidence.title: Motion-Primitives - UI kit to make beautiful, animated interfaces, faster.

name: Motion-Primitives
summary: Open-source UI kit of animated React components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.
description: Copy-paste motion components for React, Next.js and Tailwind projects: accordion, carousel, cursor, dialog, dock, image comparison and a family of text effects, plus background, in-view and group animation helpers. Each component ships documented examples, and the beta adds components regularly.
contains: 23 animated components: accordion, carousel, cursor, dialog, dock, text effects and more
text effects: loop, morph, roll, scramble, shimmer, shimmer wave
background, in-view, border trail and animated group helpers
built with Motion and Tailwind CSS
beta project, new components released regularly
